$comment: Single source of truth for which local plugins are active in which DSH profile.
tools/activate.mjs reads this file and rewrites the managed alex-* entries in
the repository's actual location on this machine. That is what makes 'clone the
repo elsewhere and run the bootstrap' work: nothing here is machine-specific.
Entries that do NOT start with managedIdPrefix are never touched (for example
llm-llamacpp, antigravity-tui-login), so hand-written per-machine config
A plugin may declare "profiles": ["dsh-tui"] to be enabled in only those
profiles; without it the plugin goes to non-isolated profiles in the list above.
Companion is isolated: general-purpose plugins list it explicitly when they belong there.
Its session tool is a preset child declared by tools/session-companion/profile.mjs; only the host bridge is managed here.
The lab profiles web, headless and tui were retired on 2026-11-13: the owner runs only dsh-tui and companion.
